read_iceberg_table: read an Apache Iceberg table from a catalog into a pandas DataFrame
read_iceberg_with_filter: read an Iceberg table with a row filter and selected columns into a DataFrame
read_iceberg_time_travel: read an Iceberg table at a specific snapshot ID for time travel querying
create_iceberg_table: write a pandas DataFrame to a new Apache Iceberg table in a catalog
append_to_iceberg_table: append a pandas DataFrame to an existing Iceberg table instead of overwriting
